key_insight: An exact verifier can teach a small language model a successful checking procedure without teaching it to find minimal explanations on unfamiliar policies.
engineering_relevance: Authorization audit explainers need separate checks for sufficiency and minimality, because a valid explanation may still include unnecessary facts.
method: Compute exact minimal sufficient reasons for decisions from executable authorization policies.
Give explainers 30 turns to probe altered requests and test candidate explanations without seeing the policy.
Compare algorithm-taught and frontier-taught fine-tuning, prompting, and exact-reward reinforcement learning.
evidence_signal: A 4B model trained on 2,000 deletion-algorithm traces reached 92% exactness on its training policy; on three unseen public policies, its answers were 94% sufficient but only 48% minimal.
watch_item: Do not assume exact feedback guarantees transferable reasoning: the learned checking schedule failed to generalize, and reinforcement learning did not improve held-out accuracy.
paper_title: Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier
